rows.title: Comptroller candidates disagree on direction of CT’s finances
rows.standfirst: Democrat Sean Scanlon and Republican Mary Fay have very different backgrounds — and they see CT’s finances headed in opposite directions.

rows.title: CT treasurer candidates seek to better manage savings, debt
rows.standfirst: The campaign between Erick Russell and Harry Arora to succeed retiring state Treasurer Shawn Wooden is coming down to a debate over expertise.

rows.title: CT employee overtime costs rise again; Total payroll still shrinking
rows.standfirst: State employee unions have argued for much of the past two years that public-sector staffing has reached a crisis point.

rows.title: Connecticut’s coffers continue to swell, despite global economic woes
rows.standfirst: New projections show revenues pushing this year’s state surplus from nearly $2.35 billion up to almost $2.8 billion.

rows.title: Legislators ready to extend CT gas tax holiday through the winter
rows.standfirst: Lamont said he wants to ensure a continued suspension of the 25-cent tax won’t impair the state’s ability to repair its roads and bridges.

rows.title: Lamont ready to extend CT gas tax holiday into the winter
rows.standfirst: Gov. Ned Lamont said he is ready to extend the CT gas tax holiday beyond its Nov. 30 expiration. Legislators may hold a special session.

rows.title: CT essential workers could see bonuses of $233, not $1,000
rows.standfirst: CT pandemic bonuses for essential workers are to be slashed. Comptroller-elect Scanlon is calling for another $100 million for the program.

rows.title: Report: CT reduced its debt by 7.4% over past year
rows.standfirst: Connecticut shaved down all major areas of debt — including pension and retirement debts — and more is expected to come off the books soon.

rows.title: CT essential worker relief caught in debate over who owes ‘heroes’
rows.standfirst: CT essential workers waiting to learn if they’ll receive $1,000 bonuses are stuck in a debate between Gov. Ned Lamont, businesses and labor.

rows.title: CT essential worker bonuses on Monday’s special session agenda
rows.standfirst: In a special session Monday, the CT General Assembly will also address an extension of the gas tax holiday and additional energy assistance.

rows.title: CT essential worker bonuses to be cut for all but lowest-income
rows.standfirst: CT Democratic leaders said they had no choice, given the limited funds Gov. Ned Lamont would support for the Premium Pay program.
